title: How it made you feel
focus: 失望、后悔、尴尬、感动、无奈、情绪、难怪、说不定
body:
# How it made you feel

Naming how something made you feel: let down, sorry, awkward, touched, or stuck.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 失望 | shīwàng | disappointed | lost hope → disappointed |
| 后悔 | hòuhuǐ | to regret (something you did or didn't do) | regret that comes after |
| 尴尬 | gāngà | awkward / embarrassing (a social situation) | walking off balance → awkward |
| 感动 | gǎndòng | moved / touched (emotionally) | feeling moved |
| 无奈 | wúnài | resigned / helpless (nothing you can do about it) | no way to cope → resigned |
| 情绪 | qíngxù | emotions / mood (often agitated or negative) | threads of feeling → mood |
| 难怪 | nánguài | no wonder | hard to find it strange |
| 说不定 | shuōbudìng | maybe / who knows, it could be (a possibility) | can't say for sure → maybe |

## Which word?

**情绪 vs 心情.** 心情 is how you feel, good or bad (心情很好). 情绪 is your emotional state, often a bad one: 情绪不好, 有情绪 = upset.

## Sentences

- 项目又推迟了，难怪客户很失望。 xiàngmù yòu tuīchí le, nánguài kèhù hěn shīwàng: The project's been delayed again, so no wonder the client is disappointed.
- 我真后悔当时没接受那个机会。 wǒ zhēn hòuhuǐ dāngshí méi jiēshòu nàge jīhuì: I really regret not taking that opportunity back then.
- 我叫错了领导的名字，好尴尬。 wǒ jiàocuò le lǐngdǎo de míngzi, hǎo gāngà: I called my boss by the wrong name. So awkward.
- 他当众道歉，我又感动又尴尬。 tā dāngzhòng dàoqiàn, wǒ yòu gǎndòng yòu gāngà: He apologised in front of everyone. I was touched, and a bit embarrassed.
- 截止日期改不了，大家又失望又无奈。 jiézhǐ rìqī gǎi bu liǎo, dàjiā yòu shīwàng yòu wúnài: The deadline can't be moved. Everyone's disappointed, but there's nothing we can do.
- 他压力太大，难怪情绪不好。 tā yālì tài dà, nánguài qíngxù bù hǎo: He's under so much pressure. No wonder he's in a bad mood.
- Ollie今天情绪不好，说不定是饿了。 Ollie jīntiān qíngxù bù hǎo, shuōbudìng shì è le: Ollie's in a mood today. Maybe he's hungry.
- 别后悔了，说不定反而是好事。 bié hòuhuǐ le, shuōbudìng fǎn'ér shì hǎoshì: Stop regretting it. It might turn out to be a good thing.

cards.Example: 这个结果让大家很失望。 zhège jiéguǒ ràng dàjiā hěn shīwàng: Everyone was disappointed by the result
cards.Notes: 失 shī lose (失去, 失败) + 望 wàng hope, look toward (希望, 看望) = lost hope. Stronger: 绝望 = hope cut off (绝 as in 拒绝), despair. 对……很失望 = disappointed in someone

cards.English: to regret (something you did or didn't do)
cards.Example: 我很后悔当时没听你的。 wǒ hěn hòuhuǐ dāngshí méi tīng nǐ de: I really regret not listening to you back then
cards.Notes: 后 hòu after (以后, 后来) + 悔 huǐ regret, 忄 heart (悔改) = regret that comes after the fact. 后悔 = regret your own choice; 遗憾 = it's a pity, often out of your control

cards.Example: 他叫错了我的名字，场面有点尴尬。 tā jiàocuò le wǒ de míngzi, chǎngmiàn yǒudiǎn gāngà: He got my name wrong, and it was a bit awkward
cards.Notes: 尴 gān + 尬 gà: both carry 尢, a lame, crooked leg; together they first meant walking unsteadily, off balance. Not built from meanings beyond that, so learn it as one word. 尴尬 describes the situation or the feeling in it; 不好意思 is the lighter, personal 'sorry / embarrassed'

cards.Example: 他说的话让我特别感动。 tā shuō de huà ràng wǒ tèbié gǎndòng: What he said really touched me
cards.Notes: 感 gǎn feel (感觉, 感冒) + 动 dòng move (运动, 动作) = feeling moved, the same image as English 'moved'. vs 激动 = 激 surge, 氵 water dashing (刺激) + 动: stirred up, excited or worked up

cards.English: resigned / helpless (nothing you can do about it)
cards.Example: 房租又涨了，我也很无奈。 fángzū yòu zhǎng le, wǒ yě hěn wúnài: The rent went up again, and there's nothing I can do
cards.Notes: 无 wú without (无聊, 无所谓) + 奈 nài way to cope (literary 奈何 'what can be done'; rarely seen outside these words) = no way to deal with it. Slightly literary; the spoken equivalent 没办法 maps exactly: 没 = 无, 办法 = 奈

cards.Example: 他今天情绪不太好，你别惹他。 tā jīntiān qíngxù bú tài hǎo, nǐ bié rě tā: He's in a bad mood today, don't provoke him
cards.Notes: 情 qíng feeling, 忄 heart (感情, 心情) + 绪 xù thread end, 纟 silk (头绪, 思绪) = threads of feeling, a mood that can tangle. 心情 = how you feel (good or bad); 情绪 = emotional state, and 有情绪 means upset or disgruntled

cards.Example: 他昨晚加班到两点，难怪这么累。 tā zuówǎn jiābān dào liǎng diǎn, nánguài zhème lèi: He worked until 2 last night, no wonder he's so tired
cards.Notes: 难 nán hard (困难) + 怪 guài find strange, 忄 heart (奇怪) = hard to find it strange: no wonder. 怪不得 (can't find it odd) means the same and is slightly more colloquial.

cards.English: maybe / who knows, it could be (a possibility)
cards.Example: 别急着走，他说不定一会儿就来了。 bié jízhe zǒu, tā shuōbudìng yíhuìr jiù lái le: Don't rush off, he might show up any minute
cards.Notes: 说 say + 不 not + 定 dìng settle, fix (决定, 一定) = can't say for sure: maybe. Mirror: 说定了 = it's settled. Livelier than 也许; suggests an open possibility.

cards.English: The project's been delayed again, so no wonder the client is disappointed.
cards.Hanzi: 项目又推迟了，难怪客户很失望。
cards.Pinyin: xiàngmù yòu tuīchí le, nánguài kèhù hěn shīwàng.
cards.Notes: 难怪 (L7) + 失望 (L7) + 项目 (L6) + 推迟 (L5) + 客户 (L6).

cards.English: I really regret not taking that opportunity back then.
cards.Hanzi: 我真后悔当时没接受那个机会。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ zhēn hòuhuǐ dāngshí méi jiēshòu nàge jīhuì.
cards.Notes: 后悔 (L7) + 机会 (L4). 后悔 is for your own choices.

cards.English: I called my boss by the wrong name. So awkward.
cards.Hanzi: 我叫错了领导的名字，好尴尬。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ jiàocuò le lǐngdǎo de míngzi, hǎo gāngà.

cards.English: He apologised in front of everyone. I was touched, and a bit embarrassed.
cards.Hanzi: 他当众道歉，我又感动又尴尬。
cards.Pinyin: tā dāngzhòng dàoqiàn, wǒ yòu gǎndòng yòu gāngà.
cards.Notes: 感动 (L7) + 尴尬 (L7). 又A又B = both A and B.

cards.English: The deadline can't be moved. Everyone's disappointed, but there's nothing we can do.
cards.Hanzi: 截止日期改不了，大家又失望又无奈。
cards.Pinyin: jiézhǐ rìqī gǎi bu liǎo, dàjiā yòu shīwàng yòu wúnài.
cards.Notes: 失望 (L7) + 无奈 (L7) + 截止日期 (L6).

cards.English: He's under so much pressure. No wonder he's in a bad mood.
cards.Hanzi: 他压力太大，难怪情绪不好。
cards.Pinyin: tā yālì tài dà, nánguài qíngxù bù hǎo.
cards.Notes: 难怪 (L7) + 情绪 (L7) + 压力 (L4).

cards.English: Ollie's in a mood today. Maybe he's hungry.
cards.Hanzi: Ollie今天情绪不好，说不定是饿了。
cards.Pinyin: Ollie jīntiān qíngxù bù hǎo, shuōbudìng shì è le.

cards.English: Stop regretting it. It might turn out to be a good thing.
cards.Hanzi: 别后悔了，说不定反而是好事。
cards.Pinyin: bié hòuhuǐ le, shuōbudìng fǎn'ér shì hǎoshì.
cards.Notes: 后悔 (L7) + 说不定 (L7) + 反而 (L2).
